caption: MCP Cancelled Notification Params
description: Parameters for a `notifications/cancelled` notification. Generated from the pinned MCP schema (2025-11-25 CancelledNotificationParams; 2026-07-28 CancelledNotificationParams).
name: mcp_cancelled_notification_params

mcp_meta.description: MCP member `_meta`: See [General fields: `_meta`](/specification/2025-11-25/basic/index#meta) for notes on `_meta` usage.

mcp_reason.description: MCP member `reason`: An optional string describing the reason for the cancellation. This MAY be logged or presented to the user.

mcp_request_id.description:
MCP member `requestId`: The ID of the request to cancel.

This MUST correspond to the ID of a request previously issued in the same direction.
This MUST be provided for cancelling non-task requests.
This MUST NOT be used for cancelling tasks (use the `tasks/cancel` request instead).

mcp_additional_members.description: Members the pinned definition does not name, exactly as reported, in source order.

mcp_nonconforming_members.description: Named members whose value does not fit the pinned definition, exactly as reported.
